name: PNP Women and Children Protection Center
description: Philippine National Police unit for reporting VAWC (Violence Against Women and Children) cases, including domestic and street-level abuse.

name: NBI Anti-Violence Against Women and Children Division
description: National Bureau of Investigation unit handling criminal investigation of VAWC cases.

name: Public Attorney's Office (PAO)
description: Free legal assistance for VAWC cases through the Department of Justice.

name: Civil Service Commission - Para sa Taumbayan
description: For workplace harassment or abuse involving Philippine government employees.

name: Makabata Helpline (Council for the Welfare of Children)
